prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape poster for a friendly neighborhood outdoor short-film screening and director conversation, intended for subway and community digital displays. Aspect ratio 16:9. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual system: a lively adult cultural invitation, built as an expressive drawn horizontal frieze with angular adult body gestures, selective vermilion and charcoal solid fills, a few decisive dark lines, and a warm light cream background. Crisp controlled edges and clean readable sans-serif type; no artificial print debris, paper distress, simulated texture, toy forms or decorative filler. The illustration must substantially communicate the actual event.

One shared creek-bank stage flows across the full width, roughly y31–69%. At left, an arriving adult visibly kneels and unrolls a broad picnic mat onto the ground. Through overlapping ground shapes, in the middle several adults sit on mats, oriented toward a clearly visible outdoor projection screen. The screen contains a simple silent film image of a bridge and flowing water, without any writing. At right, a standing adult director with a handheld microphone turns toward seated adults; an audience member reaches to exchange the microphone, conveying a conversation after viewing. This is one continuous event scene, connected by a shared ground line and river-edge railing, with a restrained bridge underside and creek cues. Give the adult silhouettes varied poses and consistent human proportions, coherent hands and object contact. Make the screening and conversation readable by their relationships, not by tiny icons. No separate frames, dividers, numbered chapters, labels or invented programme times.

Composition and information: first gaze is the vigorous title at upper left and the flowing scene beneath it. Next gaze is the upper-right schedule and venue. Keep all letters in clean cream pockets, separated from the figures. At x4–49%, y5–29%, put the Korean title on ONE complete line, firm charcoal Korean sans, approximately 40–42 px tall at a 720 px-wide viewing size, with English approximately 18–20 px beneath. Do not split the title. The schedule begins at x52%, within x52–96%, y6–29%; use stacked date, time, venue with date/time approximately 23–28 px at width720 and venue at least 17 px. Keep this upper-right group clear of the title.
Beneath the arriving mat action, lower left x4–44%, y73–95%, align three practical entries on straight baselines, at least 17 px at width720. Lower right x51–96%, y73–95%, put the screening/conversation descriptor beside the final action, with the weather contingency on a separate lower baseline. The descriptor is a single clearly readable line, at least 17 px at width720. Leave the connecting middle ground unobstructed. Use intentional common alignments and comfortable word spacing; the image gestures supply movement while text baselines stay straight.

Print ONLY these ten exact entries, each ONCE, retaining Korean spelling, English capitalization, word spaces, numbers and punctuation. The following groups specify placement, and their labels are instructions, not printed text:
Upper-left identity:
다리 아래 영화관
BRIDGE CINEMA
Upper-right schedule and venue:
2026.12.05 토요일
18:00–20:30
홍제천 연가교 아래
Lower-left arrival instructions, one entry per line:
17:30부터 입장
돗자리 지참
무료 관람 · 선착순 80명
Lower-right programme and weather:
야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화
우천 시 실내로 변경

All practical information must be legible at a 720 px-wide poster view, with intact Hangul counters and consonant/vowel proportions. Do not add any other text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark, QR code, signature or border caption. One independent poster only, edge-to-edge opaque background, no mockup, contact sheet, comparison panels, collage of posters, crop of a portrait or stretched image.
